playstyle: Five agile Sylvaneth hunters with modest health and dodge-based saves, relying on speed rather than toughness. Skaeth and Althaen pair their blades with short-range shots while flying Karthaen ranges freely, and Inspiring unlocks Grievous, Cleave and Ensnare alongside extra Move. As a vaulted warband it borrows a generic Order warscroll, either rewarding treasure grabs deep in enemy territory or striking out from friendly ground. The hunt wins by outpacing opponents, picking off isolated fighters and seizing objectives before its fragile bodies are pinned down.
